clarity.legend.title: About Clarity recordings
clarity.legend.body: Clarity does not split sessions the way GA4 does (GA4 starts a new session after 30 minutes of inactivity and at midnight; Clarity does not). As a result one recording can be attached to several session rows, and a recording may not match that row's path exactly. To line them up precisely, copy the IDs next to the recording and filter by them inside Clarity.
clarity.open.tip: Open the recording in Clarity in a new window
clarity.list.tip: Opens the Clarity recordings list (this URL form cannot identify a single recording)
clarity.user_id.tip: Clarity user ID. Click to copy it and paste it into a Clarity filter.
clarity.session_id.tip: Clarity session ID. Click to copy.
clarity.shared: ⚠ Same recording as other sessions ({count} in this period)
clarity.shared.tip: Clarity session boundaries do not match GA4's ga_session_id. This recording is attached to {count} GA4 sessions inside the displayed period, so it does not necessarily show only this row. Widening the period can increase this number.
clarity.multi.tip: This session has {count} Clarity recordings attached. Because GA4 and Clarity split sessions differently, no single one necessarily covers the whole session. Use the IDs to line them up inside Clarity.
